verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing says prompt, skill, and model changes are versioned, diffable, and reversible, which covers versioning, review, and rollback for its skills. Fixes also ship in shadow mode and only graduate after proving themselves, a form of staged review. However, this rests on one-line marketing claims with no procedural docs, and the CLI only shows in-place editing of signals with no version history. Missing for 10: documented version history, diff UI, or rollback commands for signals and alert rules; how-to docs for reverting a skill or prompt change; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
Skills and rules live in your repo as Markdown and YAML.
